Record Class StaticCompilationDecision

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticCompilationDecision
Record Components:
qualifiedName - The function, as Class.method or the module-level function's name
span - Where the function is declared, when known
outcome - The outcome
scope - The declaration that decided whether compilation was attempted
reasons - Why the body is not compiled; empty when it is
stats - What the body contains
public record StaticCompilationDecision(String qualifiedName, @Nullable SourceSpan span, StaticCompilationDecision.Outcome outcome, StaticCompilationDecision.Scope scope, List<StaticCompilationDecision.Reason> reasons, StaticCompilationDecision.Stats stats) extends Record
The decision taken for one candidate function: whether its body is compiled to Java, how the decision to attempt it was reached, and every reason it was not compiled.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher
